'''Maria Antonieta Quispe Ricalde''' (born 1971) is a Peruvian [[biologist]] from [[National University of Saint Anthony the Abbot in Cuzco]] (UNSAAC), in [[Cusco]], Peru.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |publisher=[[Andina (news agency)|Andina]] |date=2019-03-08 |title=Conoce a María Antonieta Quispe, la científica cusqueña que busca hallar la cura de la uta |url=https://andina.pe/agencia/noticia-conoce-a-maria-antonieta-quispe-cientifica-cusquena-busca-hallar-cura-de-uta-744716.aspx |access-date=2025-02-27 |language=es}}</ref> In [[Spain]], she has participated in research projects about detection and prevention of pathogenic organisms such as bacterias ''[[Yersinia]]'' and ''[[Bartonella]]'', and also has studied [[halophilic bacteria]] that can combat [[mining pollution]] while searching for a [[vaccine]] for [[Uta (disease)|uta]] (leishmaniasis) at the [[University of La Laguna]] (ULL).<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |date=2018-11-19 |title=Investigadoras de la ULL y Perú colaboran en la detección de parásitos – Periodismo ULL |url=https://periodismo.ull.es/investigadoras-de-la-ull-y-peru-colaboran-en-la-deteccion-de-parasitos-peligrosos/ |access-date=2025-02-27 |language=es}}</ref>

She is a professor and researcher at UNSAAC, directing the research lines of [[biochemistry]], [[genetics]] and [[microorganism biotechnology]].<ref name=":3" />

== Early life and education ==
Quispe was born in [[San Sebastián District, Cusco|San Sebastián]], a district of the [[Cusco province|province of Cusco]] in Peru's [[Cusco region]]. Her father, Bonifacio Quispe Cusi, was a deputy during the second government of [[Fernando Belaúnde|Fernando Belaúnde Terry]]. She studied at the Santa Ana Cusco private educational school.<ref name=":0" />

In 1997, she graduated with a degree in [[biology]] from [[National University of Saint Anthony the Abbot in Cuzco|UNSAAC]] in Cuzco. She received her master's degree in [[biochemistry]] and [[molecular biology]] from [[Cayetano Heredia University]].<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |title=Ficha RENACYT |url=https://servicio-renacyt.concytec.gob.pe/ficha-renacyt/?idInvestigador=20810 |access-date=2025-02-27 |website=Plataforma de servicio Renacyt |language=es}}</ref><ref name=":3">{{Cite web |title=CCBIPERU-2021 |url=http://ccbiperu2021.unsaac.edu.pe/simposios/biologiaCong.html |access-date=2025-02-27 |website=ccbiperu2021.unsaac.edu.pe}}</ref> In 1999, she migrated to Spain to do her doctoral thesis at [[University of La Laguna|ULL]].<ref name=":0" />

== Career ==
From 1999 to 2005, Quispe completed her [[doctorate]] in molecular [[parasitology]], receiving the honor of ''[[cum laude]]'' at ULL, Spain.<ref name=":4">{{Cite web |title=Ficha CTI Vitae: Maria Antonieta Quispe Ricalde |url=https://dina.concytec.gob.pe/appDirectorioCTI/VerDatosInvestigador.do?id_investigador=20810 |access-date=2025-02-27 |website=dina.concytec.gob.pe}}</ref><ref name=":5">{{Cite web |last=Antígona |first=La |date=2021-07-29 |title=Mujeres peruanas en la ciencia a través de la historia |url=https://laantigona.com/mujeres-peruanas-en-la-ciencia-a-traves-de-la-historia/ |access-date=2025-02-27 |website=La Antigona |language=es}}</ref>

In 2010, she began her journey to find a vaccine for uta ([[cutaneous leishmaniasis]]), she conducted research on candidate [[immunomodulatory molecules]] for the uta vaccine at ULL.<ref name=":4" /><ref name=":0" /> In 2014, she began studying [[halophilic bacteria]] that can degrade metal, thus eradicating mining pollution that affects soil and water, and also investigated the metabolism of [[arsenic]] to find bacteria that can clean up the environment.<ref name=":1" /><ref name=":5" /><ref>{{Cite web |last=PERÚ |first=Empresa Peruana de Servicios Editoriales S. A. EDITORA |date=2019-03-08 |title=Conoce a María Antonieta Quispe, la científica cusqueña que busca hallar la cura de la uta |url=https://andina.pe/agencia/noticia-conoce-a-maria-antonieta-quispe-cientifica-cusquena-busca-hallar-cura-de-uta-744716.aspx |access-date=2025-04-18 |website=andina.pe |language=es}}</ref>

In 2018, she was invited by researcher [[Pilar Foronda Rodríguez]] to do a stay at the [[Institute of Tropical Diseases and Public Health of the Canary Islands]] at ULL in Spain. Both worked on projects on the detection and prevention of zoonotic pathogens such as ''[[Angiostrongylus cantonensis]]'', ''yersinia'' and ''bartonella''.<ref name=":1" /> In the same year, she received funding to continue researching leishmaniasis.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Designan Asesora II del Despacho Viceministerial de Vivienda y Urbanismo |url=https://busquedas.elperuano.pe/api/visor_html/2006119-1 |access-date=2025-04-18 |website=busquedas.elperuano.pe}}</ref>

She continued her training at ULL and [[University of Granada]] (Spain), [[Pontifical Catholic University of Peru]] (Peru), [[Autonomous Metropolitan University]] (Mexico), etc. She speaks three languages, including English and Italian.<ref name=":4" />

She is a teacher and researcher, directing the research lines of biochemistry, genetics and microorganism biotechnology.<ref name=":3" /> She is an associate [[editor]] at UNSAAC's ''Environment, Behavior and Society Journal''.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Equipo editorial {{!}} Ambiente, Comportamiento y Sociedad |url=https://revistas.unsaac.edu.pe/index.php/ACS/about/editorialTeam |access-date=2025-02-27 |website=revistas.unsaac.edu.pe}}</ref>

== Works ==
Since 1999, Quispe has participated in many projects research in and has publicated articles in various scientific journals.<ref name=":4" /> She is a [[RENACYT]] researcher level III.<ref name=":2" />

She participated in the elaboration of the second chapter, "Los alcaloides del tarwi", with [[Omar Santiago Pillaca Pullo]] from [[Amparo Iris Zavaleta]]'s book ''Lupinus mutabilis (tarwi), Leguminosa andina con gran potencial industrial''.<ref>{{Cite book |last=Zavaleta |first=Amparo Iris (comp.) |title=Lupinus mutabilis (tarwi). Leguminosa andina con gran potencial industrial |date=2018 |publisher=Fondo Editorial de la Universidad Nacional Mayor de San Marcos |isbn=978-9972-46-620-5 |edition=1ª |location=Lima |publication-date=2018}}</ref>

== Awards and honors ==
* Distinguished visitor to the [[National University of Altiplano Puno]].<ref name=":4" />
* "Excellence in Research" Award for her performance as a teacher/researcher at UNSAAC.<ref name=":4" />
* In 2017, she won "Best research paper" award presented at the VII Research Week UNSAAC.<ref name=":4" />
* In 2018, she was one of the 11 finalists for the National Award [[L'Oréal-UNESCO For Women in Science Awards|L'Oréal-UNESCO]] "For Women in Science".<ref name=":5" />
